name: Siemens & Halske
why: Telegraph and electrical instruments for railways and state posts; precision coils and dynamos later reached households.

name: SKF
why: Self-aligning ball bearings for machinery and vehicles; the same bearing technology went into bicycles and appliances.

name: Atlas Copco
why: Pneumatic rock drills and compressors for mines and railway building; small compressors later for workshops and garages.

name: L.M. Ericsson
why: Telephone sets and manual exchanges sold to national telecom operators; the handset design soon sat on desks everywhere.

name: Corning Glass Works
why: Television bulbs, laboratory glassware and PYREX for industry and labs; heat-resistant glass later moved into kitchenware.

name: Carl Zeiss Jena
why: Microscopes and optical instruments for universities, hospitals and industry; lens know-how fed cameras and binoculars.

name: KONE
why: Electric elevators and hoists for building contractors and factories; compact hoisting gear later suited home lifts.

name: Wärtsilä
why: Diesel engines and ship machinery for shipowners, mills and power plants; compact engines later in boats and gensets.

name: Alfa Laval
why: Cream separators and plate heat exchangers for dairies and process industry; separation and heat transfer moved to marine and homes.

name: Lincoln Electric
why: Arc welders and electrodes for shipyards and fabricators; portable welders and motors later in farm and home workshops.

name: Bausch & Lomb
why: Microscopes and ophthalmic lenses for laboratories and opticians; eyeglass and lens technology reached every household.

name: Sulzer
why: Textile machinery, pumps and diesel engines for mills and shipping; pump technology now in heating and water systems.

name: Yaskawa
why: Electric motors and controls for mines and factories; inverter drive know-how later in appliances and service robots.

name: Shimadzu
why: Physical and chemical instruments and X-ray apparatus for schools, hospitals and industry; measurement spread to clinical labs.

name: Trumpf
why: Laser cutting, welding and punching machines for sheet-metal fabricators and machine builders; laser sources now in marking and medical devices.

name: SICK AG
why: Photoelectric and safety sensors for factory automation and logistics; the sensing principles underpin consumer robots and appliances.

name: Vaisala
why: Humidity, pressure and weather sensors for meteorology, pharma and industry; sensor modules also in HVAC and home weather stations.

name: Eppendorf
why: Pipettes, centrifuges and bioreactors for life-science labs and pharma; precision liquid handling reaches clinical and home testing.

name: Sartorius
why: Laboratory balances, filters and single-use bioprocess bags for pharma and labs; weighing and membrane tech also in food and medical devices.

name: Getinge
why: Sterilizers, washer-disinfectors and surgical tables for hospitals; disinfection tech also serves clinics, labs and dental practices.

name: Elekta
why: Linear accelerators, gamma knives and radiosurgery systems for hospitals; dose planning software underpins precision cancer treatment.

name: Ottobock
why: Prosthetic limbs, orthoses and wheelchairs for clinics and rehab; biomechanical components also in sports and mobility aids.

name: B. Braun
why: Infusion pumps, surgical instruments and dialysis for hospitals; sterile disposables and wound care reach home and outpatient care.

name: Terumo
why: Catheters, blood bags and oxygenators for hospitals and blood banks; needle and polymer tech also in home self-injection devices.

name: Halton
why: Commercial kitchen hoods, air distribution and indoor-climate systems for restaurants and buildings; airflow know-how also in residential ventilation.

name: Phoenix Contact
why: Industrial connectors, terminal blocks and surge protection for machine builders and utilities; the parts also sit in EV chargers and building wiring.

name: Bosch Rexroth
why: Hydraulic pumps, valves and electric drives for machinery; compact hydraulics and controls also in agricultural and garden equipment.

name: Nordson
why: Precision adhesive dispensers, coating systems and X-ray inspection for packaging and electronics; the dispensing tech reaches consumer assembly.

name: ESAB
why: Welding consumables and equipment for shipyards, pipelines and fabricators; inverter welders later sold to small workshops and hobbyists.

name: Putzmeister
why: Concrete pumps and industrial pumps for construction, tunneling and mining; pumping principles also in sewer cleaning and small mixers.

name: Vermeer
why: Trenching, horizontal drilling and hay balers for contractors and farms; compact trenchers and chippers reach rental fleets and homeowners.

name: Valmont
why: Center-pivot irrigation, poles and structures for farms and utilities; pivot and galvanizing tech also in residential irrigation.

name: Kemira
why: Coagulants, biocides and pulp chemicals for drinking-water plants and mills; polymer know-how also in home water filters.

name: Outotec
why: Minerals processing, smelting and roasting plants for mining companies; separation and thermal know-how also in recycling and battery materials.

name: Metso
why: Crushing, screening and slurry pumps for aggregates and mining; wear-part and pump designs also in recycling and small quarrying.

name: Hubbell
why: Electrical connectors, insulators and grid hardware for power companies; wiring devices later in commercial and residential buildings.

name: Victaulic
why: Grooved pipe couplings and fittings for contractors, fire protection and industry; the couplings also in HVAC and home plumbing retrofits.

name: Trojan Technologies
why: UV disinfection systems for municipal drinking water and wastewater; the UV lamps also in point-of-use and home water purifiers.

name: Helmer Scientific
why: Medical-grade refrigerators, blood bank freezers and thaw systems for hospitals and labs; controls also in pharmacy and clinic cold chain.

name: Calgon Carbon
why: Activated carbon, UV and ion exchange for drinking water and air emission control; the carbon media also in home filters and purifiers.
